items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Connie Boswell is a dear friend of mine and I knew the Boswell sisters, Connie, Martha and Bette.

ctx.x: How about Connie Boswell and Ella Mae Morris?
Yes, Connie Boswell is a dear friend of mine and I knew the Boswell sisters, Connie, Martha and Bette. They're girls from New Orleans.
They came from over in Isle of Jairs across the river, isn't it?
